notes.title: Regency Solitaire II Multi-Language Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/e7f0487fc5cbd3a045c7d50f6b0faab1798668ed.png[/img]

You can now [b]change language[/b] for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Regency Solitaire II in your chosen language!

notes.title: Update fixing level 25 and adding a minor feature (see description).
notes.content:
Fixed level 25 (very rare case of stuck situations).
Added a security check forcing the game to set the windowed mode if a previous run of the game in full screen were not ended from the UI.
